title: Personal Metrics Dashboard
hook: You think you're making progress. Without the numbers, you're mostly guessing.
statement: Track the few numbers that matter somewhere you can actually see them.
explainer: Insight doesn't come from gut feel. It comes from spotting the pattern, and you can't spot a pattern that only lives in your head.
sop: Pick 3 to 5 numbers you'd actually act on if they moved.
Log them in one place. Sticking with it matters more than the tool.
Update them on a fixed schedule.
Rate your Visibility on each from 1 to 10 before you start.
Look at the trend monthly, not just the latest number.
equation_example: No math, just a scale. Visibility at 2 out of 10, you rarely look and your read is a guess. Visibility at 8, you check weekly and trends jump out. Higher means you catch drift early. Lower means you notice once it's big.
question: Write down the 3 numbers that would tell you, at a glance, whether you're on track.
closing_statement: What you don't track, you're just guessing about.
